_comment: Early-validation preview of the v0.9 performance/scale foundation after public v0.8.2.

The inspected pre-preparation range is v0.8.2 source 40d4e72de9ab18b1c15d8c92266af2a80cabc20c through current main 0adebeabee367801b2749978b89cd0cd0fa8a78c; the actual release source is the reviewed preparation merge SHA.
Required items are completed measurement/benchmark/self-dogfood foundations already present in the candidate: #493, #502, #655 and #992.

PR #996 under open #991/#19 adds the one-process health --change-snapshot projection used for consumer dogfood; this preview ships that already-integrated seam without claiming the #991 umbrella complete.
First Ice Server exact-base acceptance proved the trust path but measured a 589.875 s median governance span (495.216-593.964 s), leaving an explicit +529.875 s GAP to the <=60 s target.
That GAP is intentional preview context: it routes further optimization to #19/#991 and residual owners rather than authorizing server-local cache or stable v0.9.0.
#19/#461/#991/#998/#999/#492/#675/#503/#650/#787 remain open and are explicitly non-blocking only for this early-validation preview.
This declaration authorizes exactly 0.9.0-preview.1. It does not authorize 0.9.0 or any other prerelease number.

Because v0.8.2 is the latest stable tag, the maintainer release handoff intentionally uses release_type=preview with version_override=0.9.0-preview.1; the exact reviewed declaration, not the override alone, is publication authority.

required_items.summary: Measure repeated candidate preparation and compare one-process versus persisted reuse before implementation
Establish reusable large-solution benchmark, complexity, memory and expected-effect evidence
Measure and disposition deferred selector, graph and repeated-work hypotheses without speculative implementation
Normalize ArchLinterNet self-dogfood CI to build-once and evidence-reuse topology before Core optimization
